contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The small stone falling from the shoe is a scene prop, not a product. One gray shoe is held in the hand and the other is worn, and they are listed as one pair. The raised foot shows only its gray sock, which informs the full sock pair. The raised knee and hand hide part of the burgundy top and the cropped pants' waist; those parts are inferred. The navy cap's far side is inferred. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: A SMALL STONE IN THE SHOE

title.en: A small stone in the shoe

deck.ko: 버건디 긴소매와 종아리 길이 검정 팬츠.
deck.en: Burgundy sleeves meet calf-length black pants.
deck.de: Burgunderärmel treffen auf wadenlange schwarze Hosen.

intro.ko: 한쪽 신발을 벗어 흔들며 발끝을 가볍게 들어 균형을 잡습니다.
intro.en: He removes and shakes one shoe while lifting the socked foot to balance.
intro.de: Er zieht einen Schuh aus und schüttelt ihn, während der besockte Fuß zum Balancieren angehoben bleibt.

body.ko: 버건디 상의의 흰 어깨선은 소매 바깥으로 이어집니다. 검정 크롭 팬츠 아래 회색 양말이 드러나고 손에 든 신발과 신은 신발이 한 켤레를 이룹니다. 네이비 캡의 흰 옆선과 검정 시계가 작은 동작을 둘러싸며 플래시는 메시와 옷의 질감을 나눕니다.
body.en: White shoulder piping continues along the burgundy outer sleeves. Gray socks show below black cropped pants; the held and worn shoes form one complete pair. A white cap side line and black watch frame the small movement while flash separates mesh and fabric textures.
body.de: Weiße Schulterpaspeln laufen entlang der äußeren Burgunderärmel. Graue Socken zeigen sich unter verkürzten schwarzen Hosen; gehaltener und getragener Schuh ergeben ein Paar. Weiße Cap-Seitenlinie und schwarze Uhr rahmen die Bewegung, während Blitz Mesh und Stoff trennt.

pull.ko: 신발을 벗은 순간 드러나는 회색 양말.
pull.en: A gray sock appears when the shoe comes off.
pull.de: Beim Ausziehen zeigt sich die graue Socke.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A gray sock appears when the shoe comes off.

tip.ko: 안정된 곳에 멈춰 돌을 털고 양말을 편 뒤 다시 신으세요.
tip.en: Stop on stable ground, empty the shoe and smooth the sock before replacing it.
tip.de: Auf festem Boden anhalten, den Schuh leeren und die Socke vor dem Anziehen glätten.

description.ko: 흰 어깨선이 소매 바깥으로 이어지는 버건디 크루넥입니다.
description.en: Burgundy crewneck with white shoulder piping continuing along the outer sleeves.
description.de: Burgunderfarbenes Rundhalsshirt mit weißer Schulterpaspel entlang der äußeren Ärmel.

howToWear.ko: 신발을 흔들 때 소매 커프가 손에 걸리지 않게 올리세요.
howToWear.en: Raise the cuffs clear of the hands while shaking the shoe.
howToWear.de: Beim Ausschütteln des Schuhs die Bündchen von den Händen fernhalten.
